title: Where Was Sodom? Archaeology Still Argues
author: QUILL
notes: Three candidates, all dashed. The 2021 airburst paper is only called 'disputed' (not 'retracted' or 'corrected'). Not-proven line in beat 11.

beats.text: Nobody agrees where Sodom actually stood.
beats.say: Nobody agrees where SOD-um actually stood.

beats.text: Abraham bargains, from fifty righteous people down to ten.
Then Genesis 19 says sulfur and fire rained from the sky.
beats.label: SULFUR AND FIRE

beats.text: Lot's wife looks back and becomes a pillar of salt.
Genesis places the cities on the plain of the Jordan.
Candidate one, Bab edh-Dhra: a walled Bronze Age town beside a huge cemetery.
beats.say: Candidate one, BAHB eh-DRAH: a walled Bronze Age town beside a huge cemetery.

beats.text: Candidate two, Numeira, a small town nearby, also abandoned in the Bronze Age.
beats.say: Candidate two, noo-MAY-rah, a small town nearby, also abandoned in the Bronze Age.

beats.text: Both lie southeast of the Dead Sea. A rival theory looks north.
beats.label: SOUTH OR NORTH?

beats.text: Candidate three, Tall el-Hammam, was a large Middle Bronze Age city.
beats.say: Candidate three, Tall el-Ham-MAHM, was a large Middle Bronze Age city.

beats.text: A 2021 paper blamed a meteor airburst there, but many scientists dispute it.
beats.source: 2021 Scientific Reports paper; disputed by many scientists

beats.text: Plainly: no dig has proven that any of these is Sodom.
beats.say: Plainly: no dig has proven that any of these is SOD-um.

beats.text: Three sites, one story, and no proof.
Bab edh-Dhra, Numeira, or Hammam: which gets your vote?
beats.say: BAHB eh-DRAH, noo-MAY-rah, or Ham-MAHM: which gets your vote?

youtube.title: Where Was Sodom? Archaeology Still Argues 🗺️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Three Bronze Age sites near the Dead Sea, each proposed as Sodom, each debated.
A 2021 airburst paper on Tall el-Hammam is disputed by many scientists. No dig has proven any of them.
#Sodom #BibleHistory #Archaeology #MythUnearthed
